doc.summary: Serve TopoGPT3 (code) + TopoExploit (red-team) as OpenAI-compatible fallback endpoints for LazyOwn / TopoSwarm.
doc.description: No changes needed in those repositories: they only need an OpenAI-compatible base URL.  TopoGPT3    -> http://127.0.0.1:8800/v1 TopoExploit -> http://127.0.0.1:8801/v1  Env: TOPOGPT3_REPO   (default /home/grisun0/src_note/py/TopoGPT3) TOPOEXPLOIT_REPO (default /home/grisun0/src_note/py/TopoExploit/repo/TopoExploit) TOPOGPT3_PORT (8800), TOPOEXPLOIT_PORT (8801) TOPOGPT3_API_KEYS (empty => no auth; set e.g. "sk-local" to require Bearer) SERVE_DEVICE ("cpu" | "cuda")
